bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to inspection. Only personal handbags and bags containing baby items are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions may be granted for guests with food allergies.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Soumande St. and Avenue du Colisée. Customers have free access to the P2B parking lot via Soumande St., except on event days when parking fees apply.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Videotron Centre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Videotron Centre offers a variety of high-quality food concessions with menus to suit all tastes and budgets, including gourmet options in premium areas. Club Bud lounge bar provides a wide selection of Labatt beers in a festive atmosphere.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Videotron Centre, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Videotron Centre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Videotron Centre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Videotron Centre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
